view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a bookstore or lounge with extensive bookshelves, circular seating areas, and patrons. The ceiling features reflective panels and recessed lighting. A central cylindrical bookshelf stands out, while arched alcoves line one wall. Large glass windows reveal an urban exterior. Warm wood tones contrast with cool blue lighting.

objects.label: bookshelves
objects.observation: Tall wooden shelves filled with books, extending from floor to ceiling on the left wall. They curve slightly inward and have warm backlighting. Some sections are recessed into arched alcoves. Books are arranged neatly in rows.

objects.label: cylindrical bookshelf
objects.observation: A spiral-shaped, multi-tiered bookshelf with glowing white rings around each level. It is centrally located and contains books. Its metallic frame reflects light. It stands independently on the floor.

objects.label: seating area
objects.observation: Circular arrangement of orange upholstered chairs with metal bases, positioned around small round tables. People are seated, some facing inward, others toward windows. Chairs are freestanding and supported by legs.

objects.label: people
objects.observation: Several individuals are seated at tables or standing near shelves. One person wears a green jacket and jeans, another a white shirt. Their postures suggest reading or conversation. They are partially obscured by chairs or tables.

objects.label: ceiling panels
objects.observation: The ceiling has recessed circular lights and large reflective panels that mirror the bookshelves below. It slopes downward toward the center. Panels appear to be suspended or mounted flush with the ceiling.

objects.label: glass windows
objects.observation: Large blue-tinted glass windows on the right wall show reflections of the interior and an urban scene outside. They are framed by dark structural elements. The glass is transparent but tinted, allowing diffused light to enter.

objects.label: tables
objects.observation: Small, round, dark-colored tables with thin metal legs, placed between chairs. Some hold drinks or personal items. Tables are freestanding and supported by legs, positioned for use by seated patrons.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000017", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
